replication.target_description: Replication Experiment 1, Hong Kong undergraduate sample, ski scenario: one-way ANOVA of likelihood of acting on the subsequent opportunity across large-difference, small-difference, and control conditions. Original Experiment 1 is explicitly identified as the ski scenario (p. 7 and Table 2 note, p. 10).

n.sample_role: Participants in the Experiment 1 ski-scenario three-condition one-way ANOVA; explicitly labelled model sample in Table 4.
n.exclusions: Main replication analysis did not further exclude participants (p. 6); separately reported supplementary analyses applied preregistered exclusions. Final Experiment 1 sample: 43 students (p. 7).
n.location: Printed p. 13, Table 4, Experiment 1 heading and Ski row; corroboration pp. 6–7 and p. 12, Table 3.

reported_success.location: Printed p. 19, Table 8, Ski, Replication Conclusion; explicit Experiment 1 exception.
reported_success.quote: Replicated: one-way ANOVA and ... large vs. small comparison (in all ... samples but Experiment 1).

notes: Identity assessment: source header gives DOI 10.1177/1948550619900570 and the mgto.org accepted-preprint PDF URL; title is Foregone opportunities and choosing not to act: Replications of Inaction Inertia effect. Title-page authors match the supplied Chen, Hui, Yu, Feldman and coauthors reference. Document is marked In press at Social Psychological and Personality Science, accepted Dec 20, 2019, and contains full methods, results and supplements: a primary accepted manuscript, not a preregistration or abstract. No supplied PDF path; layout was checked in canonical text only. Original Study 1 maps to ski from the explicit statement on p. 7 and Table 2 note, not numeric matching or row order. Table 4 appears on printed p. 13 (PDF page 15 counting title and author pages), consistent with the supplied p.15/Table 4 locator. N=43 is explicitly printed for this ANOVA, not derived from df or recruitment alone; ski groups in Table 3 are 13, 14, and 16, but no sum is needed. Reported success failed is scoped to the Experiment 1 ski ANOVA: Table 8 explicitly says the one-way ANOVA and large-vs-small comparison replicated in all samples but Experiment 1. Its broader Mostly successful summary refers to the ski scenario across four samples and is not the Experiment 1 verdict. Original side and unassigned replication es/p are placeholders only.
